{"id":1864058171,"question_id":4160,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1766568533,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"235 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1864058171/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Sum of Three Numbers Divisible by Three","memory":"291.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maximumSum(vector<int>& nums) {\n        vector<int> rem0;\n        vector<int> rem1;\n        vector<int> rem2;\n        for(int i=0; i<nums.size(); i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] % 3 == 0) rem0.push_back(nums[i]);\n            else if(nums[i] % 3 == 1) rem1.push_back(nums[i]);\n            else rem2.push_back(nums[i]);\n        }\n        sort(rem0.rbegin(),rem0.rend());\n        sort(rem1.rbegin(),rem1.rend());\n        sort(rem2.rbegin(),rem2.rend());\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        if(rem0.size() >= 3)\n        {\n            ans = max(ans, (rem0[0] + rem0[1] + rem0[2]));\n        }\n        if(rem1.size() >= 3)\n        {\n            ans = max(ans, (rem1[0] + rem1[1] + rem1[2]));\n        }\n        if(rem2.size() >= 3)\n        {\n            ans = max(ans, (rem2[0] + rem2[1] + rem2[2]));\n        }\n        if(!rem0.empty() && !rem1.empty() && !rem2.empty())\n        {\n            ans = max(ans, (rem0[0] + rem1[0] + rem2[0]));\n        }\n\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-sum-of-three-numbers-divisible-by-three","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1391}
